notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Kappa Cannoneer trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Kappa Cannoneer trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.
